method: Every NASA HLS image of one MGRS tile (T32VNR) over a 4 km square around the field, cloud-masked with Fmask; each 30 m pixel's NDVI curve classified per season with the same rules as the field's crop hints (grass/ley, autumn-sown, spring-sown, late crop, bare). Farmland = ESA WorldCover 2021 cropland or grassland (majority of 10 m cells); the field itself is excluded. A season counts when at least 30% of farmland pixels could be classified. A shift is mentioned only when a share trends the same way across the seasons (Theil–Sen, Mann–Kendall p < 0.1) and adds up to 5 percentage points or more. Broad crop types only, not named crops; not checked against farm records.
